_: The variant register. This file is the source of truth for index.html, the
portal that sits beside the variants — `npm run hub` reads it.
A VARIANT IS A FILE, NOT A BRANCH AND NOT A FOLDER. It is `indexN.html` in
this folder, published as-is, with its assets in `assetsN/`. That is the
naming every _buro test uses: _buro test 3 holds index1.html through
index20.html side by side, each with assets14/, assets16/, assets20/, and one
previews/indexN.jpg apiece. This project used to address variants as folders
on a separate gh-pages branch of a separate repository; that repository is
gone, and so is the branch. Files beside each other need neither.
Order is presentation order: newest first. `status` is free text and appears
on the card as written — 'current', 'superseded', 'experiment', a date, or
